end.summary:
Practised that a freely suspended magnet settles roughly north–south.
Practised identifying the north pole as pointing north.
Discussed keeping a compass flat so its needle can rotate.
Mahi gave 2 unaided correct responses in 4 attempts; teach-back was not passed.
The north-pole and compass-label reasoning remained mixed up at the end.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the north–south direction rule with Mahi, including keeping a compass flat so the needle can turn. Mahi correctly stated that the north pole points north and connected the idea with Earth acting like a magnet. There was a mix-up between a magnet’s labelled north pole and the rule about like poles repelling, and it was not corrected by the last response. At home, ask Mahi to draw a freely suspended magnet and label the end pointing north, then explain the rule in one sentence.
